meta.title: Privacy policy — OrentaLoan
meta.description: What data we process, why, for how long, and your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Your financial situation data is sensitive. Here, plainly, is what we do with it.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body: Identity and contact details, family, professional and financial situation you provide, and technical browsing data strictly necessary for the site to work.

sections.heading: Purposes
sections.body: To assess your financing request, contact you, meet our legal obligations and prevent fraud. No data is ever sold.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Your consent to assess the request, the performance of pre-contractual steps, and our legal obligations as a credit institution.

sections.heading: Recipients
sections.body: Only the people in charge of your file access it, together with the strictly necessary processors, bound by confidentiality.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Your data is kept for the review and then for the applicable legal periods, before deletion or anonymisation.

sections.heading: Processing in your browser
sections.body: Until you submit your request, your answers stay on your device and are not sent to us.

rights: Access, rectification and erasure of your data
Restriction of and objection to processing
Withdrawal of your consent at any time
Complaint to the data protection authority

cookies.intro: No tracker is placed without your consent. You can change your choice at any time.
